lines.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: giaan a(n)jan satigur te hoi ||
lines.translation: The ointment of spiritual wisdom is obtained from the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਤਿਹੁ ਲੋਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: raam naam rav rahiaa tihu loi ||3||
lines.translation: The Lord's Name is pervading the three worlds. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਏਕੁ ਹੋਰ ਰੁਤਿ ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kalijug mahi har jeeu ek hor rut na kaaee ||
lines.translation: In Kali Yuga, it is the time for the One Dear Lord; it is not the time for anything else.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੇਹੁ ਜਮਾਈ ॥੪॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: naanak guramukh hiradai raam naam lehu jamaaee ||4||10||
lines.translation: O Nanak, as Gurmukh, let the Lord's Name grow within your heart. ||4||10||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 3 ghar 2 ||
lines.translation: Bhairao, Third Mehl, Second House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਰੋਗਿ ਵਿਆਪੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਜਲਹਿ ਅਧਿਕਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: dubidhaa manamukh rog viaape trisanaa jalahi adhikaaee ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukhs are afflicted with the disease of duality; they are burnt by the intense fire of desire.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: mar mar ja(n)mahi thaur na paavahi birathaa janam gavaaee ||1||
lines.translation: They die and die again, and are reborn; they find no place of rest. They waste their lives uselessly. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਦੇਹੁ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere preetam kar kirapaa dehu bujhaaee ||
lines.translation: O my Beloved, grant Your Grace, and give me understanding.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੀ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: haumai rogee jagat upaaiaa bin sabadai rog na jaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The world was created in the disease of egotism; without the Word of the Shabad, the disease is not cured. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਪੜਹਿ ਮੁਨਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: si(n)mrit saasatr paRahi mun kete bin sabadai surat na paaee ||
lines.translation: There are so many silent sages, who read the Simritees and the Shaastras; without the Shabad, they have no clear awareness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਸਭੇ ਰੋਗਿ ਵਿਆਪੇ ਮਮਤਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: trai gun sabhe rog viaape mamataa surat gavaaee ||2||
lines.translation: All those under the influence of the three qualities are afflicted with the disease; through possessiveness, they lose their awareness. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਆਪੇ ਕਾਢਿ ਲਏ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik aape kaadh lae prabh aape gur sevaa prabh laae ||
lines.translation: O God, you save some, and you enjoin others to serve the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੋ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਏ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam nidhaano paaiaa sukh vasiaa man aae ||3||
lines.translation: They obtain the treasure of the Name of the Lord; peace comes to abide within their minds. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਉਥੀ ਪਦਵੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਰਤਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: chauthee padavee guramukh varatahi tin nij ghar vaasaa paaiaa ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukhs dwell in the fourth state; they obtain a dwelling in the home of their own inner being.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੀਨੀ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: poorai satigur kirapaa keenee vichahu aap gavaaiaa ||4||
lines.translation: The Perfect True Guru shows His Mercy to them; they eradicate their self-conceit from within. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕਸੁ ਕੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਰ ਏਕ ਜਿਨਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਰੁਦ੍ਰੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: ekas kee sir kaar ek jin brahamaa bisan rudr upaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Everyone must serve the One Lord, who created Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਏਕੋ ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਇਆ ॥੫॥੧॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak nihachal saachaa eko naa ohu marai na jaaiaa ||5||1||11||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the One True Lord is permanent and stable. He does not die, and He is not born. ||5||1||11||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Bhairao, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਰੋਗੀ ਰੋਗੀ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh dubidhaa sadaa hai rogee rogee sagal sa(n)saaraa ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukh is afflicted with the disease of duality forever; the entire universe is diseased.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਵਾਵਹਿ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh boojhahi rog gavaavahi gurasabadee veechaaraa ||1||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh understands, and is cured of the disease, contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har jeeu satasa(n)gat melaai ||
lines.translation: O Dear Lord, please let me join the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਦੇਇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜੋ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak tis no dei vadiaaee jo raam naam chit laai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Lord blesses with glorious greatness, those who focus their consciousness on the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਮਤਾ ਕਾਲਿ ਸਭਿ ਰੋਗਿ ਵਿਆਪੇ ਤਿਨ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਹੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: mamataa kaal sabh rog viaape tin jam kee hai sir kaaraa ||
lines.translation: Death takes all those who are afflicted with the disease of possessiveness. They are subject to the Messenger of Death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਜਮੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh praanee jam neR na aavai jin har raakhiaa ur dhaaraa ||2||
lines.translation: The Messenger of Death does not even approach that mortal who, as Gurmukh, enshrines the Lord within his heart. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਸੇ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਕਾਹੇ ਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin har kaa naam na guramukh jaataa se jag mahi kaahe aaiaa ||
lines.translation: One who does not know the Lord's Name, and who does not become Gurmukh - why did he even come into the world?

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਕੀਨੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: gur kee sevaa kade na keenee birathaa janam gavaaiaa ||3||
lines.translation: He never serves the Guru; he wastes his life uselessly. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak se poore vadabhaagee satigur sevaa laae ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, those whom the True Guru enjoins to His service, have perfect good fortune.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਇਛਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: jo ichhahi soee phal paavahi gurabaanee sukh paae ||4||2||12||
lines.translation: They obtain the fruits of their desires, and find peace in the Word of the Guru's Bani. ||4||2||12||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Bhairao, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਦੁਖਿ ਮਰੈ ਦੁਖ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: dukh vich ja(n)mai dukh marai dukh vich kaar kamaai ||
lines.translation: In pain he is born, in pain he dies, and in pain he does his deeds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਨਿਕਲੈ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: garabh jonee vich kade na nikalai bisataa maahi samaai ||1||
lines.translation: He is never released from the womb of reincarnation; he rots away in manure. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhrig dhrig manamukh janam gavaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Cursed, cursed is the self-willed manmukh, who wastes his life away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ਨ ਕੀਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: poore gur kee sev na keenee har kaa naam na bhaaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: He does not serve the Perfect Guru; he does not love the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਭਿ ਰੋਗ ਗਵਾਏ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kaa sabad sabh rog gavaae jis no har jeeu laae ||
lines.translation: The Word of the Guru's Shabad cures all diseases; he alone is attached to it, whom the Dear Lord attaches.
